purpose: Define the complete timed happy-path authority that a later human-accepted receipt may activate without mid-run approval prompts.

git_policy.preparation_baseline_sha: must be derived by task-58 after the separately approved baseline transaction
git_policy.actual_timed_range_sha: must be derived immediately before the timed push
git_policy.actual_stable_range_sha256: must be calculated and verified immediately before the timed push

designated_roles.child_implementation_writer: logical role of codex while holding the timed writer lease
designated_roles.root_integration_owner: exclusive preparation and child publication writer
designated_roles.concurrency: exactly one physical source/Git writer at a time

owner_handoffs: root integration owner publishes the preparation baseline and releases
designated timed writer executes positioning through accepted canonical validation and releases
root integration owner reacquires only for the child publication node and releases
designated harness resumes read-only exact-SHA, route, and reveal receipt verification
root integration owner later owns bundle and root projection closeout
authorized_happy_path_after_activation: mutate only event-allowlist.json paths using their allowed operations
run local validation and production-safe smoke tests
create at most four bounded in-scope commits
perform one normal non-force push to origin/main
inspect the two existing Vercel production projects and deployments read-only
verify /demo/3/ and /demo/3/output/ with bounded public GET requests
refresh and verify the program bundle through the root integration owner
record public-safe local evidence and checkpoints

validity_window.not_before: task-58 has published the approved preparation baseline, HEAD equals origin/main, the root writer lease is released, and event-authority-activation.json verifies
validity_window.expires: the earliest of T0+30:00, explicit revocation, identity drift, owner/lease drift, origin drift, or exhausted repair policy
validity_window.wall_clock_window: supplied by the later human-accepted event-authority receipt; this policy does not invent one

post_publication_activation_receipt_sche.verification: all bound identities must match; actual_published_baseline_sha must equal fetched origin/main and be a linear descendant of the accepted origin

publication_eligible_paths.child: Only the exact publication_eligible_paths enumerated in event-allowlist.json under presentations/ai-native-sdlc-demo/runs/demo-003/.
publication_eligible_paths.rule: These are ordinary dirty-state paths, not exceptions; stage them only after the child local and canonical validation gates and writer handoff.

local_evidence_only_inventory.rule: These paths may change locally for Goal 6 and Goal 7 evidence but are excluded from the preparation manifest and every timed push.

forbidden_actions: force push, history rewrite, unrelated integration, or unlisted paths
DNS, Vercel project/environment/alias configuration, manual redeploy, or analytics
new dependencies, lockfile edits, tags, package publication, or remote runtime assets
editing the run binding, immutable seal, child interface, sendoff, allowlist, lease, approval, or validity window from the child
storing credentials, tokens, cookies, raw provider payloads, or private context
invalidation_conditions: the preparation tree or separately approved path inventory changes
the designated harness, owner handoff, lease, branch, or remote changes
a required action is not explicitly authorized
the deadline or repair policy is exhausted
human_acceptance_rule: Task 33 may create event-authority.json only after task-32 binds the quiet-window lease and verified fallback, and the user explicitly accepts the resulting complete authority receipt.
